title: Crunchyroll to Stream The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime in India
content: Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will stream the anime adaptation of Hifumi 's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) light novel series in the Indian subcontinent.

title: Netflix Streams The Ribbon Hero Anime Film in India on August 8
content: The film will premiere exclusively on Netflix worldwide on August 8. Netflix describes the story: Sapphire is the princess of a kingdom that no longer exists. Having lost everything in her homeland of Silverland to the calamity known as “Nergal,” she wanders in despair until she finally arrives in Goldland.

title: Junket Bank TV Anime Reveals 2 New Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Ikkō Tanaka 's Junket Bank manga revealed two new cast members on Wednesday. The anime's staff also revealed that the series will air on the TV Tokyo channel and its affiliates every Monday at 24:00 JST in October.
author: ANN

title: Additional Cast Pair for 'Junket Bank' Announced
content: The official website of the television anime adaptation of Ikkou Tanaka 's Junket Bank manga announced an additional pair of cast on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo affiliates at 12:00 a.m. every Tuesday beginning in October 2026.

title: Mercedes and the Waning Moon Reveals First Visual, Trailer, Staff, Cast, January 2027 Release
content: Mercedes and the Waning Moon TV anime adaptation revealed its first visual and trailer, along with a January 2027 release date. The main voice cast and staff were also announced. The anime was first announced in August 2025. Anna Nagase will voice Mercedes Grünewald.

title: The Sparks of Tomorrow Anime Expo Premiere Made Electricity a Religious Experience
content: From the earliest moments that Sparks of Tomorrow began to play on the many projector screens across the Anime Expo panel room, I felt certain that this would be one of, if not the, best anime this season.
